proposal.reason: Main substantive change is in contribution/review automation: review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py redesign module-based invitation/approval gating, new review-gate/review-module/review-command/review-squash-preview workflows rewire that process, and commit_message_squash.py plus commit_attribution.py add squash-preview/attribution policy enforcement; docs/catalog edits support this same workflow policy.
